description: All 24 Technicks accounted for; three party-only utility improvements, existing mechanics otherwise retained. Native command identity, MP, range, targets, acquisition and prices stay unchanged.

commands.name: First Aid
commands.help: Heal a critical ally for at least 10% max HP.
commands.reason: Guarantee the old reduced-roll mean while retaining its roughly 20% upper roll; critical-only emergency healing stays distinct from Cure and medicines.

commands.name: Shades of Black
commands.help: Cast a random spell from the curated selection.
commands.reason: Already has a curated weighted pool; keep its free but unpredictable caster fallback without layering another random system.

commands.name: Horology
commands.help: Time-based area damage, at least level x10.
commands.reason: Its zero/low clock windows can waste a turn. A modest 10-times-level floor raises the clock-cycle mean about 9%, retaining its 81-times-level peak and existing accuracy.

commands.name: Stamp
commands.help: Copy your harmful status effects to one foe.
commands.reason: Copies eligible ailments and remaining durations; deliberate ailment preparation already supports Chemist and status play. Preserve immunity checks.

commands.name: Achilles
commands.help: Give a foe a random new elemental weakness.
commands.reason: Choose among elements not already weak so a successful cast adds one opening. Preserve Safety, accuracy and native resistance-removal behavior.

commands.name: Charge
commands.help: Restore your MP. Failure leaves you at zero.
commands.reason: Low-MP recovery already has a clear risk. Keep its success check, level-based return and empty-MP failure rather than creating free reliable Ether.

commands.name: Infuse
commands.help: Spend all MP to set an ally's HP to MP x10.
commands.reason: Current formula 100 already trades all caster MP for matched ally HP. It can lower HP or be lethal at zero MP; keep that distinct resource exchange.

commands.name: Souleater
commands.help: Spend 20% HP for a powerful weapon-based hit.
commands.reason: Already inherits Arsenal attack and target defense; retain the native HP cost, damage factor and undead branch.

commands.name: Wither
commands.help: May lower one foe's Strength by 30%.
commands.reason: An existing physical-pressure answer with native Safety and accuracy gates; preserve the native stacking semantics rather than silently changing bosses.

commands.name: Addle
commands.help: May lower one foe's Magick Power by 30%.
commands.reason: The matching magic-pressure answer already works through native gates; preserve its individual role and existing enemy behavior.

commands.name: Bonecrusher
commands.help: Try to crush a foe. Failure costs all your HP.
commands.reason: An explicit risky execution tool. Keep Safety, accuracy, random HP sacrifice and lethal failure rather than adding repeatable max-HP damage.

commands.name: Steal
commands.help: Attempt to take an item from one foe.
commands.reason: Manifesto Smart Steal is the existing provider. Preserve rarity tables, Thief's Cuffs and exhaustion handling; no duplicate stealing hook.

commands.name: Telekinesis
commands.help: Strike flying foes with a grounded weapon.
commands.reason: Already supplies a weapon-based answer to flying foes. Preserve its grounded-weapon eligibility, target-level roll and existing range.

commands.name: Expose
commands.help: May lower one foe's Defense by 30%.
commands.reason: Legacy's existing party-only 0.7 defense wrapper already closes this gap; retain it and native enemy casts.

commands.name: Shear
commands.help: May lower one foe's Magick Resist by 30%.
commands.reason: Legacy's existing party-only 0.7 magick-resist wrapper already closes this gap; retain it and native enemy casts.

commands.name: Charm
commands.help: Confuse a foe so it attacks friend and foe.
commands.reason: Already gives non-casters enemy-control utility through Confuse. Preserve immunity, Safety, chance and duration behavior.

commands.name: Revive
commands.help: Sacrifice yourself to fully revive an ally.
commands.reason: Full revival for the caster's life is a meaningful four-member-party exchange. Keep KO checks and the real sacrifice.

commands.name: Sight Unseeing
commands.help: While blind, reduce a foe to single-digit HP.
commands.reason: Already a powerful Blind-preparation and Poach setup tool; preserve its accuracy, blind requirement and protected-foe gates.

commands.name: Numerology
commands.help: Damage doubles with success. A miss resets it.
commands.reason: Native global counter grows only at the cast boundary, caps at 17 and resets on failure. Keep that high-risk exponential identity without a second counter or per-target increments.

commands.name: Libra
commands.help: Reveal target details and nearby traps.
commands.reason: Existing preparation tool supported by No Anti-Libra and foe UI; preserve its native information and status behavior.

commands.name: Poach
commands.help: Capture a critical foe for its Poach loot.
commands.reason: Keep the native critical-HP gate, capture, common/rare selection and 5% rare roll. Revisit ingredient usefulness in the separate Bazaar pass.

commands.name: 1000 Needles
commands.help: Deal exactly 1000 damage to one foe.
commands.reason: Keep its fixed-damage niche and existing accuracy checks. Level or max-HP scaling would erase the identity and risk repeatable boss damage; enemy clone 538 remains untouched.

commands.name: Traveler
commands.help: Area damage uses steps since the last cast.
commands.reason: Already rewards prepared movement with nonlinear thresholds. Preserve modulo-1000 step consumption and one cached amount shared by the cast's targets.

commands.name: Gil Toss
commands.help: Spend gil to damage foes in the target area.
commands.reason: The existing bounded gil expenditure and split among active targets already make it a distinct resource-for-damage choice. Preserve the cap, split and payment.
